meta.title: Full-Page Screenshots for Chrome & Firefox — OpenScreenShot
meta.description: Capture full-page screenshots in Chrome and Firefox. Annotate and save as an image or PDF, all on your device. Free and open source. No account required.

hero.title2: Fully local. Private. Easy to use.
hero.sub: Capture pages in Chrome or Firefox. Add annotations, then save an image or PDF. No account required.
hero.wip: Desktop and web apps are in development
hero.credit: Screenshots feature OpenTechCheck, our website technology lookup tool.

quartet.title: Capture a page or region
quartet.body: Take a full-page screenshot, capture the visible area, or select a region. Use the toolbar, right-click menu, or a keyboard shortcut.

quartet.title: Edit before you share
quartet.body: Add arrows, shapes, and text. Crop the screenshot, copy it to your clipboard, or export as PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF.

quartet.title: Record a browser tab
quartet.body: Record a tab in Chrome, zoom in on clicks, and trim the video before exporting as MP4 or WebM.

quartet.title: Process everything locally
quartet.body: Capture, editing, and export run on your device. The extension does not upload your screenshots or recordings, or track your usage.

privacy.heading: Your captures stay on your device.
privacy.lede: Screenshots, recordings, and edits are stored in your browser. We do not receive them. No account is required, and the extension has no analytics or telemetry. Website access is granted when you use it; broader access for recording across sites is optional.
privacy.micFine: Your browser asks for permission before enabling the microphone or camera. Their audio and video are processed locally.
privacy.moreFine: Read the full privacy policy for details on storage and permissions.
privacy.compareLine: Compare OpenScreenShot, GoFullPage, and FullPage Capture

useCases.title: Document incidents
useCases.body: Capture dashboards and status pages for incident reports, runbooks, and postmortems. Run captures from a script or a connected MCP client.

useCases.title: Capture pages in CI
useCases.body: Add screenshots to your build pipeline for documentation, release notes, and visual comparisons. Requires Chrome in your CI environment.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.moreFine: Find more answers and known limitations on the support page.

cta.heading: Take your first screenshot

steps.title: Add it to your browser
steps.body: Install OpenScreenShot from the Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons. No account is needed.

steps.title: Capture a page
steps.body: Click the extension icon to capture the full page. Right-click for visible-area or region capture.

steps.title: Edit and save
steps.body: Add annotations, then copy the screenshot or save an image or PDF. Exports have no watermark.

cta.browsersFine: Screenshots work on desktop Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc and other Chromium browsers. Recording is Chrome-only.
